scope: Dated reconciliation; each observation has its own source/time. This file is not a live monitor or a release authorization.

requirements.completion_rule: All necessary cases at the original minimum evidence tier; merged code and feature flags cannot establish acceptance.

merged_source.limitation: This main commit is not evidence of a member-portal deployment.

fresh_health.resolver: fresh Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS, per-request --resolve; TLS hostname verification retained

production.limitation: Public health proves this endpoint/release identity, not every feature, private DB schema, or cloud private-AI acceptance.

fresh_http.resolver: fresh Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS, per-request --resolve; TLS hostname verification retained

staging.limitation: Fresh Access 302 is not authenticated health; release identity comes from the earlier operator receipt.

last_operator_rollout.limitation: Private originals retained by operator; no credentials/member data included. Selected checks are not full foundation acceptance.

deployment.execution_mode: Explicitly authorized private operator invocation for an exact source; no automatic GitHub Release trigger was verified.
deployment.manifest_semantics: freedom.project.yaml deployment.trigger=published_release declares the v1 production release policy. Installed automation, signed release provenance and actual deployment observations are separate evidence; policy conformance is not inferred from this value.

schema.limitation: The latest rollout reports no migrations applied. Neither health nor main manifest proves the current SQL ledger; re-read exact names/digests/roles before the next schema or recovery operation.

topology.limitation: Cluster name contains candidate but is the live cluster; historical topology was not re-enumerated from provider credentials in this research.

media.legacy_bytes: retained; historical 27-item observation is not a new live count

private_ai.reason: Cloud/client/official CLI and end-to-end acceptance incomplete; OFF does not close requirements.

features.limitation: No fresh authenticated feature/DB/R2 inspection in this research.

limitations: Same Cloudflare account; no independent account disaster boundary
No fresh restore of source567/current full schema

recovery.operator_source_note: The coordinator and native workflow intentionally use the same c3e commit for different purposes; daily-scheduled-2026-10-05.json records operator_source independently.

governance_pins.selection: The exact configured SHA fixes workflow bytes; main is a mutable ref descriptor, not an immutable branch claim.

governance_pins.purpose: Approved shared library artifact source; distinct from preview contract and workflow source
